title: Equal output lengths form a polynomial-time language
statement: Let $f,g$ be polynomial-time computable functions from finite binary strings to finite binary strings. The language of inputs $z$ for which $|f(z)|=|g(z)|$ belongs to $\mathsf{P}$.
replaced: Let $f, g : \{0,1\}^* \to \{0,1\}^*$ be polynomial-time computable functions (each computed by some finite binary Turing machine within $C(n+1)^c$ steps on inputs of length $n$, for some constants $C, c$). Then the language $\{z \in \{0,1\}^* : |f(z)| = |g(z)|\}$ belongs to $\mathsf{P}$, the class of languages decidable by a deterministic Turing machine in polynomial time.
